envelope.description: Find the earlier request of the chosen artifacts

body.title: Find the earlier request of the chosen artifacts
body.summary: Make openSignoff decide, before it publishes anything, which earlier request the chosen artifacts belong to: read the LAST entry of signoffsOfMeta of each head whatever its revision; when it is open or changes-requested ask readSignoffRequest whether that request is still open; refuse artifacts that name different earlier requests; never fall back to a new request when the read itself fails; and fall back to opening a new request, as in s7, when the earlier request is merged or closed, the port has no readSignoffRequest, or there is no earlier entry. This task only decides; it does not push or record.
acceptanceChecks: The earlier request is taken from the last Signoff entry of any revision, not from signoffViewOf
A failed read of the earlier request returns that failure and opens no new request
A merged or closed earlier request, a port without readSignoffRequest and a head with no earlier entry each lead to a new request as in s7
Artifacts naming different earlier open requests are refused as a whole, asking for separate submissions
